probabilistic_ensemble.sampling: validated input distributions with seeded Python RNG
probabilistic_ensemble.summary: descriptive statistics over accepted deterministic simulations

validated_invariants: EDV exceeds ESV for accepted samples
stroke volume is positive for accepted samples
ejection fraction is between 0 and 100 percent
cardiac output is finite and positive
seeded requests reproduce samples and summaries
accepted and rejected sample counts reconcile
known_limitations: Input proxies are sampled independently; no validated joint correlation model is available.
Local SQLite durability requires a persistent shared filesystem.
Pointwise pressure-volume loop uncertainty is not returned by the backend.
Component uncertainty is limited to explicitly mapped scalar output metrics.
Browser and assistive-technology behavior require manual environment validation.
